                                                                          Wu Zhixiang
                                                                              吳志祥
                                                Co-Chairman of the Board and Executive Director
                                                                  董事會聯席董事長兼執行董事




I am very pleased to present you our annual report for the year ended             本人欣然提呈我們截至二零五年十二月三十一
December 31, 2025.                                                                日止年度的年報。


BUSINESS REVIEW AND OUTLOOK                                                       業務回顧與展望
After a period of recovery and reacceleration, China’s travel industry            中國旅遊業在經歷需求復甦與再加速後，於二
transitioned toward quality-driven development in 2025. Over the past year,       零二五年進入高質量發展階段。過去一年，消
consumer demand showed sustained resilience, with heightened tourist              費者需求呈現持續的韌性，節假日期間旅遊熱
enthusiasm during holidays and resilient travel activities throughout the year.   情高漲，全年旅遊活動亦保持活躍態勢。值得
Notably, there has been a growing consumer appetite for exploring niche           注意的是，消費者探索小眾目的地、尋求沉浸
destinations and seeking immersive, personalized experiences, indicating that     式及個性化體驗的需求日益增長，這表明旅遊
travel has evolved into an important consumption category that addresses          已成為滿足消費者情感需求與情感聯結的重要
consumers’ desire for emotional fulfillment and meaningful connections.           消費形式。

     CHAIRMAN'S STATEMENT
     董事長致辭

change on derivatives. Adjusted net profit for the year is defined as profit       本及衍生工具的公允價值變動。年內經調整溢

with the opportunities to acquire interests in Shares.

with flexible means of remunerating, incentivizing, retaining, rewarding,         酬、激勵、挽留、獎勵、補償及 ╱ 或向合資格

below); (b) to align the interests of Eligible Participants with those of the     通過向合資格參與者提供購買本公司股權的機
Company and Shareholders by providing such Eligible Participants with the         會，使該等合資格參與者的利益與本公司及股
opportunity to acquire shareholding interests in the Company; and (c) to          東的利益保持一致；及(c)鼓勵合資格參與者為
encourage Eligible Participants to contribute to the long-term growth and         本公司的長期增長及盈利能力作出貢獻，並為
profitability of the Company and to enhance the value of the Company and          本公司及股東的整體利益提升本公司及其股份
its Shares for the benefit of the Company and Shareholders as a whole.            的價值。

In order to achieve diversity across the workforce (including senior               為實現全體員工（包括高級管理人員）
management), the Company has adopted the Workforce Diversity                       多元化，本公司已採納員工多元化政
Policy, which aims to foster a workplace culture that respects                     策，旨在營造一個尊重多元化背景的
and embraces diverse backgrounds. The Workforce Diversity                          工作環境。員工多元化政策涵蓋招
Policy covers all aspects of recruitment, training, promotion and                  聘、培訓、晉升及日常管理各個層
day-to-day management, and emphasizes fair treatment of all                        面，強調在性別、年齡、種族、宗教
employees regardless of gender, age, race, religion or any other                   或其他受法律保護的特徵方面對所有
legally protected characteristics.                                                 員工公平對待。


A summary of the Workforce Diversity Policy is set out below:                      員工多元化政策之概要載列如下：


Purpose:                             The Workforce Diversity Policy aims to foster a workplace culture that respects and
                                     embraces diverse backgrounds, and to ensure the Company’s compliance with the
                                     relevant requirements under the Listing Rules.
目的：                                  員工多元化政策旨在營造一個尊重多元化背景的工作環境，及使本公司遵守上市
                                     規則的相關規定。


Statement:                           The Company regards workforce diversity as an essential element in supporting the
                                     attainment of its diversity and inclusion objectives. In recruiting, training, promoting
                                     and managing all members of the workforce (including senior management), the
                                     Company will be guided by a range of diversity attributes, including but not limited
                                     to gender, age, race, nationality, cultural background, skills and experience, with the
                                     final decision based on the merits of the candidate and the contribution he or she can
                                     bring to the overall development of the Company. All opportunities for recruitment,
                                     promotion and development are based on individual merit, qualifications and business
                                     needs, without bias and discrimination.
聲明：                                  本公司視員工多元化為支持我們達到多元化和包容性目標的必要元素。本公司在
                                     招聘、培訓、晉升及管理全體員工（包括高級管理人員）時，將以一系列多元化
                                     範疇為基準，包括但不限於性別、年齡、種族、國籍、文化背景、技能及經驗等
                                     因素，最終將按人選的優勢及可為公司整體發展所提供的貢獻而作決定。所有招
                                     聘、晉升及發展的機會均基於個人能力、資歷及業務需求，杜絕偏見和歧視。


Measurable objectives:               The Company will regularly review the diversity of its entire workforce (including
                                     senior management) and, where appropriate, establish plans or measurable objectives,
                                     including but not limited to numerical targets, timelines, and other relevant measures.
                                     The ESG Committee will review, manage and oversee the implementation of the
                                     Workforce Diversity Policy from time to time to ensure the effectiveness of the policy.
可計量目標：                               本公司將定期審閱全體員工（包括高級管理人員）多元化情況，並根據需要設定計
                                     劃或可計量的目標，包括但不限於數字指標、時間表及其他相關措施。環境、社
                                     會及管治委員會將定期審閱、管理、監督本政策的實施。

      As a lessee, the Group’s leases are mainly in connection with                作為承租人，本集團的租賃主要關於
      land-use-rights with lease term of 50 years and leases of buildings          租期為 50 年的土地使用權以及租期通
      or vehicles typically for lease terms from over 1 years to 20                常介乎1年以上至20年的樓宇或車輛的
      years. Lease terms are negotiated on an individual basis and                 租賃。租賃條款按個別基準磋商，並
      contain a wide range of different terms and conditions. The lease            包含各種不同的條款及條件。租賃安
      arrangements do not impose any covenants, but leased assets                  排並無施加任何契諾，惟租賃資產（土
      (other than land-use-rights) may not be used as security for                 地 使 用 權 除 外 ）不 得 用 作 借 款 的 抵 押
      borrowing purposes.                                                          品。


      Contracts might contain both lease and non-lease components. The             合約可能包含租賃及非租賃組成部
      Group allocates the consideration in the contract to the lease and           分。本集團根據租賃及非租賃組成部
      non-lease components based on their relative stand-alone prices.             分的相對獨立價格分配其合約中的代
                                                                                   價。


      The lease payments are discounted using the interest rate implicit           租賃付款使用租賃中隱含的利率進行
      in the lease. If that rate cannot be readily determined, which is            貼現。倘無法輕易確定該利率（為本集
      generally the case for leases in the Group, the lessee’s incremental         團租賃的一般情況），則使用承租人的
      borrowing rate is used, being the rate that the individual lessee            增量借款利率，即個別承租人在類似
      would have to pay to borrow the funds necessary to obtain an                 經濟環境中按類似條款、抵押及條件
      asset of similar value to the right-of-use asset in a similar economic       借入獲得與使用權資產具有類似價值
      environment with similar terms, security and conditions.                     的資產所需資金而必須支付的利率。

  are used for economic hedging purposes (instead of being speculative               用作經濟對沖用途（而非投機性投資）的衍
  investments) to manage the Group’s foreign exchange risk. However,                 生工具合約以管理本集團的外匯風險。然
  these derivative contracts do not meet the hedge accounting criteria               而，該等衍生工具合約不符合對沖會計準
  and hence they are classified as “held for trading” for accounting                 則，因此就會計目的而言彼等被分類為「持
  purposes and are accounted for as financial assets/(liabilities) at fair           作買賣」並入賬列作按公允價值計量且其變
  value through profit or loss.                                                      動計入損益的金融資產 ╱（負債）。


  The full fair value of hedging derivatives is classified as a non-current          當對沖項目的剩餘到期日超過 12 個月時，
  asset or liability when the remaining maturity of the hedged item is               對沖衍生工具的全部公允價值被分類為非
  more than 12 months. It is classified as a current asset or liability when         流動資產或負債。當對沖項目的剩餘到期
  the remaining maturity of the hedged item is less than 12 months.                  日少於 12 個月時，其被分類為流動資產或
  Trading derivatives are classified as a current asset or liability.                負債。交易衍生工具被分類為流動資產或

      26. TRADE PAYABLES (CONTINUED)                                                               （續）
                                                                                          26. 貿易應付款項
          Trade payables are obligations to pay for goods or services that have            貿易應付款項為就於日常業務過程中向供
          been acquired in the ordinary course of business from suppliers.                 應商獲取的貨品或服務的付款責任。倘貿
          Where trade payables are settled via electronic cash transfer, they are          易應付款項通過電子現金轉賬結算，則當
          derecognized when the Group has no ability to withdraw, stop or cancel           本集團無法提取、停止或取消付款、因電
          the payment, has lost the practical ability to access the cash as a result       子支付指示而失去實際使用現金的能力時
          of the electronic payment instruction, and the risk of a settlement not          終止確認該等款項，無法進行結算的風險
          occurring is insignificant.                                                      並不重大。


          Trade payables are classified as current liabilities if payment is due within    倘貿易應付款項於一年或更短時間內到期
          one year or less. If not, they are presented as non-current liabilities.         支付，則分類為流動負債，否則呈列為非
                                                                                           流動負債。


          Trade payables are recognized initially at fair value and subsequently           貿易應付款項初步按公允價值確認，其後
          measured at amortized cost using the effective interest method.                  則使用實際利率法以攤銷成本計量。

      37. RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS                                                      37. 關聯方交易
          Parties are considered to be related if one party has the ability, directly          倘一方有能力直接或間接控制另一方，或
          or indirectly, control the other party or exercise significant influence             能對另一方的財務及經營決策行使重大影
          over the other party in making financial and operation decisions. Parties            響力，則雙方被視為關聯方。倘雙方受共
          are also considered to be related if they are subject to common control.             同控制，亦被視為關聯方。本集團主要管
          Members of key management and their close family member of the                       理層成員及彼等的近親亦被視為關聯方。
          Group are also considered as related parties.


          Save as disclosed in elsewhere in these consolidated financial                       除本綜合財務報表其他章節所披露者外，
          statements, the following significant transactions were carried out                  以下重大交易乃由本集團及其關聯方於截
          between the Group and its related parties during the years ended                     至二零二五年及二零二四年十二月三十一
          December 31, 2025 and 2024. In the opinion of the Directors, the related             日止年度內進行。董事認為，該等關聯方
          party transactions were carried out in the normal course of business                 交易乃於日常業務過程中按本集團與各自
          and at terms negotiated between the Group and the respective related                 關聯方磋商的條款進行。
          parties.

           Subsidiaries are fully consolidated from the date on which                 該實體有控制權。附屬公司自控制

           Unrealized losses are also eliminated unless the transaction               有證據顯示所轉讓資產出現減值，

           When necessary, amounts reported by subsidiaries have been                 要時，將會對附屬公司呈報之金額

          41.13 Provisions                                                               41.13 撥備
              Provisions are recognized when the Group has a present legal or               倘本集團因過往事件而具有現時法定
              constructive obligation as a result of past events; it is probable that       或推定責任，而履行該等責任可能需

              and the amount has been reliably estimated. Provisions are not                地估計，則會確認撥備。未來經營虧
              recognized for further operating losses.                                      損毋須確認撥備。


              Where there are a number of similar obligations, the likelihood               如有多項類似責任，則在償付時所需
              that an outflow will be required in settlement is determined by               的流出的可能性乃根據責任類別的整
              considering the class of obligations as a whole. A provision is               體考慮而釐定。即使在同一責任類別
              recognized even if the likelihood of an outflow with respect to any           所包含的任何一個項目相關的資源流
              one item included in the same class of obligations may be small.              出的可能性極低，仍須確認撥備。


              Provisions are measured at the present value of the management’s              撥備採用反映當時市場對金錢時間值
              best estimate of the expenditures expected to be required to settle           及責任特定風險之評估之稅前比率，
              the obligation using a pre-tax rate that reflects current market              按照管理層對預期履行責任所需支出
              assessments of the time value of money and the risks specific to the          之最佳估計之現值計量。隨著時間流
              obligation. The increase in the provision due to passage of time is           逝而增加之撥備確認為利息開支。
              recognized as interest expense.

              the loss allowance).                                                          備後）。

              as to produce a constant periodic rate of interest on the remaining         以計算出各期間負債結餘的固定週期
